appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md to reflect that route lines are rendered via imperative gmp-polyline-3d custom elements (not a library-exported Polyline3D React component) in @vis.gl/react-google-maps v1.8.2.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify frontend-worker behavior when Chrome DevTools MCP cannot connect by documenting required recovery attempts and an explicit fallback/return decision rule.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both map3d feature reviews reported DevTools MCP connection/lock failures in worker handoffs while implementation continued; current skill guidance is not explicit enough for consistent handling.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add chrome-devtools service lifecycle commands directly to .factory/services.yaml.
Frontend-worker zero-failure test policy conflicts with mission-level expected failing tests.
